recognize_zh: 周邊血液拼圖中多顆中等大小的淋巴細胞，核圓形、卵圓或腎形，細胞質淡藍紫色且邊緣呈不規則、四周放射狀的細毛突起，是毛細胞白血病的典型毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round, oval or bean/kidney-shaped nuclei with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin
Moderate pale blue-violet cytoplasm with irregular, ruffled circumferential hair-like projections
Background red cells normochromic; scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite) shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, oval or kidney-shaped nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have moderate amounts of pale blue-violet cytoplasm with irregular, circumferential hair-like projections. Background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells show a distinct central nucleolus, higher WBC counts, and are CD25-negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL cells have short polar villi at one or two poles and more clumped chromatin rather than circumferential projections.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm containing distinct azurophilic granules and no hairy projections.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin, fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles.
